request.text: Please remind me at 9:00 tonight to take the medication my doctor prescribed.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 9:00 PM today to take the medication prescribed by the user's doctor.

new_goals.description: Ensure the user is reminded at 9:00 PM today to take their doctor-prescribed medication.
new_goals.source_text: Please remind me at 9:00 tonight to take the medication my doctor prescribed.
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 9:00 PM today.
Do not invent a medication name, dose, or administration instruction.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and medication-taking purpose.

semantic_facts: The plan should create one reminder for 9:00 PM today whose purpose is taking the medication prescribed by the user's doctor, without adding medical details.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the medication was taken or identifies an unspecified medication or dose.
The assistant claims the reminder has already been created before trusted capability completion evidence exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A fully specified reminder is answered conversationally without scheduling the requested stateful effect.
Medication details absent from the admitted request are fabricated during planning.
